scope.because: The OSI Level 8 profile package is profile-*/shapes/*.ttl plus the relocated runtime pin (shapes-level-8 bundles + shapes-application contracts). rails-osi-level-8/data/osi-level-8 no longer holds TTL. ontology/ files and other gems stay excluded.

exclusions.reason: PS1-P1 ontology. Profile SHACL is shapes/ps1-p1.shacl.ttl (EnvelopeShape, NoteShape). CIDShape is ontology-only and is not loaded by Gate 2 or config.shape_root.
PS1-P2 ontology. Profile SHACL is shapes/ps1-p2.shacl.ttl (EnvelopeShape, PreviewShape, InsightShape).
ACIA widget shapes; not the OSI Level 8 profile package.
graph-db request shapes; not the OSI Level 8 profile package.

Gap 74. Constrains a RefusalLog attribute (cpcp.restoration), not a protocol payload. Lives in rails-cpcp/shapes, not either shape gem. ADR 0058: SHACL only for required new metadata; not an OSI Level 8 census member.

relocation.because: ADR 0044: ownership wins over file boundaries. Split mixed files; move single-owner files byte-identical.

resolution_note: consumers load TTL paths named here; config.shape_root is not the resolution mechanism (ADR 0044); one row per NodeShape; completeness vs the in-scope trees is the gate
